headlines.description: Danny Welbeck scored his first Chelsea goal as Xabi Alonso's side beat Luton Town 2-0 at Stamford Bridge in the Carabao Cup second round.
headlines.shortLinkText: Welbeck scores on debut as Chelsea beat Luton

headlines.description: Rodri made a winning return to LaLiga as Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 at Camp Nou on Thursday thanks to goals from Raphinha and Fermín López.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodri debuts as Barça continue hot LaLiga start
